ownerRules: For a student with one authoritative current D1 Maths 11+ programme, normal Maths Year full-library access remains available but does not become an additional current teaching programme unless that normal Year also has its own current D1 assignment.
Historical/full-library access must be preserved; presentation demotion to Previous is not deletion or entitlement revocation.
L1, L2 and L3 Full Library access may coexist as current 11+ ladder access when the current authoritative D1 programme is L3.
SATS remains a separate entitlement-driven presentation and does not define or change the student's teaching programme.
11+ Practice eligibility remains D1 Maths 11+ assignment-driven.

11+ Practice released lesson context must be derived from actual student core lesson entitlements, intersected with the live L2/L3 view, and must not be inferred merely because Full Library makes a lesson appear open.

implementation.quizReleaseEvidence: lesson_entitlements.core_access=1 intersected with the live L2/L3 lesson view
